committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 31 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Average CPC is A$8.12 over the last 7 days (16 clicks, A$129.98 spend) with zero conversions, while the landing page test sits at 73 raw clicks, approaching the 75-click checkpoint.
30-day impression share is 10%, with 75.7% lost to rank versus 17.3% lost to budget; no external account changes were recorded in the last 24 hours or 7 days (status ok).
Since the test started, ask_cta_click has fired 17 times against 73 raw paid clicks, while review_cta_click and generate_lead both sit at zero; the page has been frozen since click 25.
AI Assistant sessions fell to zero this week from 2 last week with no top source logged, while Organic Search rose to 11 sessions from 7, still the only trustworthy unpaid signal.

actions.text: Update the logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups (Agency and Job Intake).
Revise the RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads that still claim 13.3 hours of admin saved per week and 99.6% success, align them with current site stats.
